main_text.l: absq; sanguinis effusione non fieri remissionem, dicit Christum in coelum ingressum esse, ut appareat nunc in conspectu Dei pro nobis. Heb. 10. v. 12. Christus una pro peccatis oblata victima, in perpetuum sedet ad dextram Dei, &c. Deniq; ubi reconciliationis & pacificationis mentio fit, aperte indicatur, Deum nobis propitium factum esse Christi sacrificio: etsi hoc ipsum sacrificium ipse, qui prior dilexit nos, procuravit. 1. Joh. 4. v. 10. In hoc enim est caritas, non quod nos dilexerimus Deum, sed quod ipse dilexerit nos; et misit Filium suum, ut esset propitiatio pro peccatis nostris.
Christum itaque mihi propositum, placamentum per fidem in sanguine ejus, & pro peccatis meis propitiationem merito retineo & adoro, ut suo Merito, & corporis sui Sacrificio Reconciliatorem meum.
Vivere & proprie, verum pretium redemtionis nostra persolvendo nos redemit, is utiq;[?] nobis satis fecit. Atqui Christus Jesus vere & proprie, verum pretium redemtio-nis no-

page.notes: Handwritten "262" at the top right corner is not printed and is left out. The mark before "Atqui" is a printed ornament or dagger, not a letter, and is left out. "utiq;" is followed by a sign that may be an abbreviation for pro (ꝓ) and is marked [?]. The text ends mid-word on "no-" and continues on the next page. Woodcut initial V of "Vivere" is joined to the word. The marginal numbers and roman numerals are read from a small type at the scan edge and may be off.
